### New Features 🥳
 - **Added content-aware image shrinking with `Vision.carve()`**
 - **Added Hough line, line-segment and circle detection, and Harris corner detection:**
     - **`houghLineSegmentDetection()`**
     - **`houghCircleDetection()`**
     - **`harrisCornerResponse()`**
     - **`harrisCorners()`**
 - **Added higher-quality resizing with bicubic, Catmull-Rom, Mitchell-Netravali and Lanczos interpolation**
 - **Modernized image loading, exporting and framework conversions with `ImageIO`**
 - [***Check The Changelog For More Details***](https://github.com/ShaharMS/Vision/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

### Bugfixes & Tweaks 🛠️
 - **Fixed behavior across image processing, linear algebra, geometry, colors and byte arrays**
 - **Improved cross-target reliability, including Lua PNG export and `vision_quiet` fixes**
 - **Replaced generated test scaffolding with authored behavioral tests and fixed CI failure reporting**
 - **Included reproducible build tools for the qualified cppia interpreter host** - uses the included compatibility patch; JIT mode is not qualified.
 - **Improved release packaging and removed the test-only `utest` runtime dependency**
 - [***Check The Changelog For More Details***](https://github.com/ShaharMS/Vision/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
